name: GFX_hof_ic_zinovyev_trade_unions
title: 论工会的作用
concept: A wide factory assembly gateway embraced by a large gear, five worker figures gathering through its open center beneath two plain union banners, small globe medallion overhead. Organized workers as a collective, emphasize people and assembly rather than chimneys.
prompt: Create ONE finished Hearts of Iron IV Soviet national focus icon, matching reference 1 frame and bas-relief style but completely replacing central subject. Theme: A wide factory assembly gateway embraced by a large gear, five worker figures gathering through its open center beneath two plain union banners, small globe medallion overhead. Organized workers as a collective, emphasize people and assembly rather than chimneys. Common frame: deep crimson circular medallion, antique GOLD laurel branches with top gap, red star at top, blank golden ribbon below. Central subject ivory/plaster grey sculpted bas-relief unless specified cold variant, upper-left light, readable dark shadows, bold clear silhouette at 100x88 pixels. No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no portrait of a leader. Landscape canvas 100:88 aspect, emblem fills about 94% canvas, 20-50% transparent pixels. TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND ENABLED: output RGBA PNG actual alpha zero outside isolated emblem, including all four corners. Never simulate transparency with checkerboard or solid rectangle. Red backing stays inside medallion only.
